task_handling: Implement approved user-facing outcomes; make ordinary technical choices without extra permission

free: UI structure, interaction, copy drafts, component decomposition, CSS, local tests, ordinary refactors and test migrations
adopt low-risk frontend packages after verifying docs/license and reporting
ask_first: change the canonical engineering model or electrical formulas
promote unsupported manufacturer/electrical facts to verified
overwrite remote main or irreversibly remove data

delivery: Provide working code plus visible browser evidence and test output, not a new research report

current_session.next_action: Build interactive client from zero without copying rejected frontend

history_policy: Keep one compact project session record and an append-only line-oriented event log. Do not generate research Markdown by default.
